tips: Saare visuals cards hain — slideshow feel aa sakta hai. PEXELS_API_KEY ya HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY daalo, ya scenes ko 3-4 hi rakho.
Voice silent hai kisi scene me — edge-tts install karo (pip install edge-tts) ya VoiceStudio app chalu karo (port 3900).
Captions burn nahi hue — accessibility ke liye --no-captions hata do.

hardware_note: 6GB VRAM / 16GB RAM safe — heavy generation cloud/app me (optional)
